ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (~85-90%) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered across the central lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black zone forming the fluke core. High-intensity white contiguous zones at both distal tips. Heterogeneous distribution of small circular white blobs (2-10 pixel radius) and linear white streaks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 95 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. The trailing edge follows a mostly smooth continuous curve with minor pixel-level irregularities isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups concentrated in the lower central peduncle region and scattered sparsely across the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented primarily in diagonal trajectories across both left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface. Large, textured brown-to-dark-grey protrusion (likely a barnacle colony) attached to the extreme right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast dark textured mass located on the outer edge of the right fluke tip.
